image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tiger beetle resting on a textured, earthy surface (soil/leaf litter). The beetle exhibits a metallic green and bronze exoskeleton with distinct cream-colored markings on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes, and long, slender legs are visible gripping the ground. Antennae are present but partially blend with the background.
